description: This Java source file defines the ExceptionDialogFragment class, which is a dialog fragment used to display exception details and tips within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles displaying stack traces, copying debug info to clipboard, and managing throwable exceptions.

classes.name: ExceptionDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that displays exception details, stack trace, and tips, allowing users to copy debug info or close the dialog.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the list of throwables from fragment arguments.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog UI, including setting up the tips adapter, displaying debug info, and handling button actions.

methods.name: newInstance (ArrayList<Throwable>)
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the dialog fragment with a list of exceptions.

methods.name: newInstance (Throwable)
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the dialog fragment with a single exception.
